assets.prompt: Vault Custodian, a living limestone temple sentinel for a serious medieval RPG. A balanced human-height stone body with proportionate broad chest, solid arms and legs, small blunt three-fingered hands. Head has the solemn outline of a plain greathelm but is continuous naturally weathered stone with one deep narrow horizontal aperture. Torso and limbs are continuous carved limestone, never a suit of armor on a man. Joints are deep flexible shadowed folds between overlapping worn stone surfaces, with no circular pivots, metal machinery or mechanical fingers. Pale warm limestone has dense gray veins, faint ocher mineral layers, chisel scars and softened chipped edges. Modest blue woven oath sash at waist. Neutral watchful guardian of an old maintained shrine. No horns, no bulky boulder stacking, no robot parts.

reasons: Actual source PNG passes intact coherent face requirement.
Unmistakably floating with legless spectral tails
Dark hood and claws convey serious fantasy without gore or science fiction

assets.prompt: Veil Reaper, a floating wilderness predatory spirit for a serious medieval RPG. A balanced substantial upper body with two strong proportionate arms ending in three hooked fingers. The head is shaped like a downward folded slate hood, its face a single deep vertical seam rather than a human skull or mask. Four broad layers of blue-gray leathery hide form a short mantle grown from the shoulders. The lower torso tapers into one broad split spectral tail, two curling gray-plum veils drift in open air without legs or feet. Pale salt streaks on dark hide, small dim amber light deep in the facial seam. Suspended a short distance above the ground, neutral poised floating posture, no scythe, no skeletal thinness, no corpse anatomy.

assets.prompt: Pallid Shade, a floating wilderness echo spirit for a serious medieval RPG. assets.prompt: Grave Lantern FACE REVISION THREE. Edit this exact reference image. Preserve the entire oval cage of dark petrified wood, central warm ribbed amber light organ, three moderately thick root limbs and broad root pads, two short branch feelers, weathered wood grain, pale lichen, copper resin scars, balanced body, pose and plain gray background. Add one compact intact head of naturally grown dark wood at the top front of the cage, clearly ABOVE the amber light and connected by a short sturdy neck. The head is a complete solid rounded wood volume, with a calm mature face: two small deep-set amber eyes beneath a firm brow, a broad short solid nose bridge and one CLOSED horizontal mouth above a firm chin. Fine continuous wood grain crosses the entire face; shallow carved features read as an old living woodland spirit, not a separate mask or human skin. Keep the head modest in size, no horns or antlers, no cute features, no long reptile muzzle. No missing face, blasted cavity, central slit, radial mouth, hollow head, fleshy lips, paired lobes or genital-like folds. The amber light remains strictly in the chest and must not become a face hole. Serious PG-13 medieval fantasy RPG shrine guardian. Change only this head addition and preserve every other body detail and full-body framing.

history.prompt: Grave Lantern revision two. An unfamiliar mobile woodland grave ward, its entire torso a vertically oval open cage of dark petrified wood enclosing one ribbed amber glass light organ. Exactly three moderately thick jointed root limbs radiate evenly from the bottom of the cage, each ending in a broad blunt three-lobed root pad. No separate head, neck, face, snout, jaw, shoulders, hips or tail. Two short strong curved branch feelers emerge beside the amber organ to touch old stones. The organism senses through the warm amber body, not eyes. Continuous weathered wood grain flows through torso and root limbs, dark umber resin folds at joints, uneven pale gray lichen and copper growth scars. Waist-high, balanced weight with ordinary strong limbs, neutral patient shrine keeper. Natural living fantasy anatomy with a lantern-shaped body, never a turtle, dinosaur or animal carrying a lantern.

assets.prompt: Banshee, a floating wilderness mourning ghost for a serious medieval RPG. Full adult female upper body with balanced anatomy, stern long face with closed eyes and gray lavender skin, mouth slightly open in a solemn breath. Dense dark hair forms two broad swept-back locks joined into a short heavy braid. Faded midnight-blue burial gown with a woven silver hem. The empty lower gown opens into three broad curling ribbons of pale blue mist that taper in open air, unmistakably hovering above the ground, no legs or feet beneath. Proportionate arms separated from torso, wrapped forearms and relaxed visible hands. Restrained lavender light at throat, quiet mournful menace, no exposed bones, no gore, no shredded rag cloud.

assets.prompt: Chainbound Archon, a tall wilderness judgment construct with an adult athletic humanoid silhouette. assets.prompt: Furnace Regent revision two. A serious wilderness kiln-stone sovereign, large balanced humanoid body formed from continuous weathered fired clay with proportionate muscular limbs. The upper torso rises into one hollow sloping craggy kiln arch where a head would be. Inside the arch is a deep irregular dark cavity with dim orange embers at its back, no face, eyes, cheeks, mouth, nose, helmet or mask. Old lumpy terracotta surfaces have fine mineral grain, broad natural erosion hollows and uneven soot deposits. Irregular branching ember fissures run only through the lower ribs and left shoulder, never repeated straight slots. Strong four-fingered rough clay hands and wide plain feet, ordinary shoulders and forearms, no separate armor plates or machine joints. A short ash-gray woven waist mantle hangs from a simple rope. Substantial yet balanced build, dignified unsettling presence, restrained heat rather than fire covering the body.
